answer: An agent economy can make each identity post a refundable stake and gain reputation only through randomly assigned work checked independently by established agents. A challenge protocol compares their signed outputs; contradictory collusion evidence slashes the bonded accounts. A Sybil operator must lock capital behind every fake identity and risk losing many deposits when fabricated agents coordinate, while fresh accounts cannot cheaply inherit trusted history. Whether an account is called crystal, marble, or gale, its label adds no protection.
